answer: In a nebula of agents, give each agent one anchor identity that may hold only a single live session identity at a time; spawning a new session revokes the old one, and every session inherits the anchor's permanent public audit trail. An attacker wanting a thousand sockpuppets must pay full onboarding cost for a thousand anchors, and one fraud taints its anchor forever, so the sable record of misbehavior follows every new disguise. Honest agents move cheaply like a sparrow between sessions, while a Sybil farm must buy a fresh anchor for each fake, making mass fakery cost more than any gain.
